name: Mark Barry
source:
He constantly boasts about having an older brother who became a knight, but no one has ever met them. He is responsible for the morning duties and has a general passion for his job. He is always working hard when chief is here and hopes he will become a knight one day. At the same time, he is saving up for the expensive armor and war horse. 

He creates poems in this spare time and often sings them to strangers, especially ladies walking past. A few hearts fell for him, but he never noticed.

[Edited from in-game bio]
